tree: Models, billing, credits, and how your data is handled.

items.question: What is the H Company Models API?
items.answer: The Models API gives developers direct access to H Company's Holo models: multimodal models for real-world use that process text, images, and documents, with computer-use capabilities for any digital environment. It is OpenAI-compatible: point the OpenAI client at https://api.hcompany.ai/v1 with your H API key. A rate-limited free tier is available, with pay-as-you-go pricing beyond.

items.question: What is Holo4 and how does it perform?
items.answer: Holo4 is H Company's newest model family for computer-use agents. Holo4 27B (dense) scores 85.2% on OSWorld and gives the best accuracy on long, multi-step tasks across web, desktop, and mobile. Holo4 35B-A3B (mixture of experts, 3B active parameters) scores 80.8%, cheaper and faster. Both take text and images and have a 262,144-token context.

items.question: How much does the Models API cost?
items.answer: The Models API is billed per million tokens. Holo4 27B costs $0.40 input, $0.04 cached input and $3.00 output; Holo4 35B-A3B costs $0.30, $0.03 and $2.00; Holo3.1 35B-A3B costs $0.25 input and $1.80 output, and is also available on a rate-limited free tier with no credit card required.

items.question: Can I run Holo models locally?
items.answer: Yes. Holo4 35B-A3B is published as open weights under Apache 2.0, and Holo4 27B weights are available for research (non-commercial) use. Download the checkpoints on Hugging Face and serve Holo4 or Holo3.1 with vLLM or llama.cpp, then point the same API client at your server so screenshots and prompts stay on your network.

items.question: Which Holo4 model should I use?
items.answer: Start with Holo4. Holo4 35B-A3B is the default for production computer-use workloads: longer context, strong accuracy, and low cost and latency. For denser flagship-class reasoning on complex multi-step tasks, use Holo4 27B. Earlier Holo3 models remain available on the same Models API if you need them. Switching only requires a model ID change.

items.question: How to get started with Holo4 models?
items.answer: First, create an account on H Platform. You can generate an API key on the free tier, then add credits from the same interface when you need higher limits. See the documentation for the full quickstart.

items.question: How can I contact support?
items.answer: Reach out to us at support@hcompany.ai specifying the nature of your request.

items.question: How does inference billing work?
items.answer: Inference is billed per model and per million input and output tokens. Rates vary by model and may change over time. Refer to our terms of use for current details.

items.question: How to monitor my usage?
items.answer: The credit dashboard on H Platform shows your current balance and a detailed breakdown of top-ups and usage. We are still improving it to show usage more clearly.

items.question: Do credits expire?
items.answer: Per our terms of use, we reserve the right to expire unused credits one year after purchase.

items.question: I can't see my credits. What should I do?
items.answer: Payment can take a few minutes to process, please allow up to 15 minutes. If your credits still do not appear, confirm that you have been charged and have received a payment receipt or invoice. If you have not been charged, your card may have been rejected, try again with another one. If you can confirm you have been charged and still do not see credits, contact us at support@hcompany.ai with your purchase so we can investigate.

items.question: My credit balance is negative. How is that possible?
items.answer: This may happen if your balance is low and your next request uses a lot of tokens. When you submit a request, we first check your balance to allow or reject processing. However, if your remaining balance is low, the input and output tokens required to process your request may exceed your remaining balance. A negative balance should only be a few cents. If you see the negative balance increasing or have any doubts, contact us at support@hcompany.ai.

items.question: What is the refund policy?
items.answer: According to our terms of use, credits are not refundable by default. Depending on your profile and region, refund obligations may apply. Please check our terms of use to learn more.

items.question: Do you offer a free tier?
items.answer: After registering on H Platform, every user is assigned to the free tier, which provides rate-limited access to Holo3.1 35B-A3B. Holo4 models require a paid tier. If you need a higher rate limit, add credits to move to a paid tier.

items.question: What data is logged and retained?
items.answer: We only record basic logging information, such as your request time and the model used, including token counts. By default, the Model API uses zero data retention and does not save your prompts or responses. Learn more on our privacy policy.

items.question: Do you share data with other third parties?
items.answer: Our API is hosted by a secure cloud provider. H Company processes its own models, so none of your inputs (prompts) or outputs are shared with any third parties. For paid accounts, we only share your registration with a secure Payment Service Provider to process payments, billing, and your credit balance. Learn more on our privacy policy.
